implementation_defects_corrected.defect: Pro-rata largest-remainder ties were compared as floating-point fractional parts, so exactly equal remainders were ordered by float noise instead of arrival_sequence, violating the frozen tie-break rule.
implementation_defects_corrected.measured: 12 contract-violating allocations in 5680 on sentinel runs; the error correlated with resting size, the channel under measurement.
implementation_defects_corrected.fix: Exact integer arithmetic: floor = (demand*size)//total, remainder key = (demand*size) % total.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: 120000 randomised cases against an exact-rational reference, zero mismatches.

implementation_defects_corrected.fix: Cancel and replace to full display size when resting quantity falls below target, which is the correct exchange semantics for a top-up.
implementation_defects_corrected.verified: Mean displayed size 9.15 and 8.81 after the fix; the residual shortfall is the latency window between a fill and the replacement landing.

research_question: Under an identical prespecified synthetic order-flow realization and latency model, how do price-time priority and pro-rata allocation differ in execution quality and queue outcomes for a tracked passive parent order?

hypotheses.null: Allocation mechanism has no effect on the decision metric at the matched-latency baseline.

A.name: price-time priority
A.allocation: resting orders filled in (price, arrival_sequence) order

B.name: pro-rata
B.allocation: proportional to resting size at the best price
B.min_allocation_semantics: participation floor, not a guaranteed allocation
B.under_allocation_rule: When the aggressor quantity is smaller than the number of eligible resting orders, no order is guaranteed a lot. Pass 1 allocates floor(demand * size_i / total) capped at size_i, which is zero for any order whose share is below one whole lot. Pass 2 awards the remaining lots one at a time by descending fractional remainder, ties broken by lower arrival_sequence. Pass 3 sweeps lots stranded by size caps in arrival_sequence order.

under_allocation_worked_examples.resting: X=1 lot (seq 1), Y=1 lot (seq 2), Z=1 lot (seq 3)
X=1 lot (seq 1), Y=1 lot (seq 2), Z=5 lots (seq 3)

order_flow.state_independence_rationale: The complete intent stream is drawn before any book exists and never consults book state, so both mechanism arms provably consume the same realization and the identity control is a hash comparison rather than a promise.

event_schema.intent_id: Every LIMIT intent carries a unique immutable intent_id assigned at generation. It is the resting order id in every arm.
event_schema.limit_price: book_relative: price = opposite_best - offset * tick for BUY, opposite_best + offset * tick for SELL, with offset drawn uniformly from 1..levels_from_opposite_best at generation and resolved against the arm's own book on arrival. Absolute prices may therefore differ across arms while the intent is identical. If the opposite side is empty on arrival the intent is a counted no-op (limit_no_op) and its intent_id never rests.
event_schema.cancel_target: Every CANCEL intent carries a target_intent_id fixed at generation. For each LIMIT intent i, cancel_at_i = t_i + Exponential(rate = cancel_rate_per_resting_lot_per_sec * size_i), with the hazard fixed at placement on the placed size and never re-drawn after partial fills. A cancel whose target is not resting when it lands, because it was filled, already cancelled or never placed, is a counted no-op (cancel_no_op).
event_schema.market_order: Executes against the arm's own book. An empty opposite side is a counted no-op (market_no_op). Quantity beyond available depth executes the available depth and the remainder lapses.
event_schema.seeded_ladder: The ten initial ladder orders are intents 1..10 at t = 0 at the absolute prices in initial_book_state.ladder, included in the hash, and cancellable under the same hazard.
event_schema.identity_hash_scope: sha256 over the canonical serialization of the full pre-mechanism intent stream (seq, t, kind, side, size, offset, intent_id, target_intent_id). Resolved book coordinates and no-op outcomes are mechanism-dependent by design and are not hashed.
event_schema.horizon_counting: events_per_run_after_warm_up counts intents of all three kinds in the merged time-ordered stream.

participants.background: non-adaptive zero-intelligence agents; sizes drawn from the frozen distribution; no strategic response to mechanism

tracked_agent.style: passive limit at best bid, replenished
tracked_agent.reprice_rule: cancel and replace when best bid moves
tracked_agent.replenishment: cancel and replace to full display size when resting quantity falls below min(display_lots, remaining); topping up loses time priority

participants.declared_limitation: Zero-intelligence agents do not inflate order size. The simulator therefore cannot reproduce strategic size inflation, which is the principal real-world behavioural consequence of pro-rata allocation.

latency.model: per-agent constant one-way latency, no jitter
latency.background_latency_dynamic_effect: none under the frozen non-reactive participant assumption
latency.matched_baseline_meaning: reference cell for the decision metric; no latency parity is claimed, because background latency has no dynamic effect under non-reactive agents

ladder.placement_order: bid level 1, ask level 1, bid level 2, ask level 2, and so on, taking arrival_sequence 1..10

fees.rationale: Maker-taker pricing interacts strongly with pro-rata allocation and would confound the mechanism comparison. Zero fees are frozen and are a declared limitation.

primary.definition: Perold implementation shortfall of the whole parent order, buy side: 1e4 * (sum_i p_i * q_i + (Q - E) * P_T - Q * P_0) / (Q * P_0), where Q is parent_quantity_lots, E is executed lots, (p_i, q_i) are fill price and lots, P_0 is the reference mid at arrival and P_T is the reference mid at the frozen horizon end.
primary.zero_fill_and_timeout_rule: E = 0 gives 1e4 * (P_T - P_0) / P_0, so the run enters the decision statistic as pure opportunity cost. No run is excluded, imputed or treated as missing, and every seed pair is complete by construction.
primary.reference_mid_rule: M(t) is the arm's own mid at the latest instant at or before t at which both book sides were non-empty, initialised to initial_mid_price 1000, which the seeded ladder guarantees at t = 0. P_0 is M at the first measured event and P_T is M after the last measured event. A run whose P_0 or P_T is carried forward is flagged arrival_mid_carried_forward or horizon_mid_carried_forward and retained.
primary.horizon_rule: Every run executes all events_per_run_after_warm_up events regardless of fill state. The horizon end is the frozen event count, never the full-fill time.

primary.definition: size-weighted mean quoted spread at each fill
time_to_first_fill_ms and time_to_full_fill_ms; queue measure is volume_ahead_at_best under FIFO and size_share_at_best under PRO_RATA

comparability.queue_measure: descriptive_only; volume_ahead_at_best is in lots and size_share_at_best is a fraction, so they are different units and are never differenced across mechanisms
comparability.wait_time: time_to_first_fill_ms and time_to_full_fill_ms are the cross-mechanism queue comparison

primary.sampling: queue measure sampled at each placement of the tracked display order; the run value is the mean over placements, and null if the tracked agent never quoted

primary.definition: 1e4 * (P_T - P_0) / P_0 using the same reference mid rule as implementation shortfall

decision_metric.statistic: mean of per-seed paired differences d_s = IS_PRO_RATA(s) - IS_FIFO(s) over the frozen seeds
decision_metric.bootstrap: BCa on the 30 per-seed differences; each resample draws 30 seeds with replacement and recomputes the mean of d_s

identity_run.description: For each seed, the serialized pre-mechanism intent stream must be byte-identical across both mechanisms.
identity_run.verification: Pre-run: sentinel seeds only. Post-run: sha256 equality of the per-run intent-stream digest between mechanisms for every executed (seed, latency, cell) triple in the retained records.
identity_run.state_independent_note: The cancel intensity is applied per intent as a placement-time hazard rather than against live book state, which is what makes the identity claim testable.

zero_latency_control.description: Tracked agent at 0 ms one-way latency: the tracked_agent_one_way_ms = 0 cell of the main grid.
zero_latency_control.background_latency: Background agents are non-reactive zero-intelligence agents and the exogenous stream is defined as the exchange-side arrival process, so background_one_way_ms has no dynamic effect: a uniform shift of the background stream is invisible to every outcome. All agents at 0 ms and tracked agent at 0 ms therefore coincide.

analytic_sanity_case.description: One aggressive market order of 6 lots meets two resting orders at the same price: order X of 2 lots (arrival_sequence 1) and order Y of 10 lots (arrival_sequence 2).

deterministic_replay.description: Re-running from (seed, config) must produce a byte-identical per-run output record.
deterministic_replay.verification: sha256 equality of the per-run JSON record

robustness_cell.change: order_size_distribution_lots replaced by a constant 1 lot for background intents
robustness_cell.purpose: Sets background order size to a constant 1 lot. This removes background size heterogeneity, and also reduces mean background order size from 2.75 to 1.0 lots and lengthens per-order lifetime, so aggregate book depth co-varies. ASSUMPTION_DRIVEN therefore indicates sensitivity to that joint change rather than to size heterogeneity alone. The tracked display order stays at 10 lots, so pro-rata does not reduce to price-time priority in this cell.

NULL.rule: The BCa 95 percent confidence interval of the mean paired difference at the matched-latency baseline contains zero.

UNSTABLE.rule: Evaluated only when NULL does not hold. Let n_plus and n_minus be the counts of strictly positive and strictly negative per-seed differences at the matched baseline, excluding exact zeros. UNSTABLE holds when the exact two-sided binomial sign test of n_plus against n_minus gives p greater than 0.05.

LATENCY_DRIVEN.rule: Evaluated only when NULL does not hold. Let D5 be the point estimate at the matched baseline and D0 the paired point estimate at the zero-latency control. Holds when the paired BCa 95 percent interval at 0 ms contains zero AND the absolute value of D0 is at most 0.5 times the absolute value of D5.

ASSUMPTION_DRIVEN.rule: As LATENCY_DRIVEN, with the constant_order_size robustness cell at the matched baseline in place of the zero-latency cell.

negative_result_criteria.reporting: criteria_met lists every label that holds. The headline verdict is the first held label in precedence order. NULL is exclusive by construction because the other labels are conditioned on NULL not holding.

required: all five primary metrics for every cell
count and description of retained degenerate runs
at least three retained failure or edge-case runs
prohibited: any claim that either mechanism is a superior market design
cross-reference to unrelated prior auction or mechanism-design work by the builder

claim_boundary: Synthetic simulation only. Conclusions are valid solely for the two frozen mechanisms under this frozen order-flow process, participant assumptions, latency model and fee schedule. This is not evidence of real-market performance, realized returns, predictive alpha, profitability, market-quality superiority, or exchange deployability.
